about: KICK = INTERRUPT ONLY (V3 Dev, 2026-10-27, Dom: the Minotaur fell on one kick and often; a kick can be spammed so it must not knock down). moves.kick.perMille is 0: no force, no knockdown. A clean kick cancels his windup/attack with a short stagger (kick.interruptSeconds), then he resists further interrupts for kick.resistanceSeconds, and the kicker's own next kick waits kick.cooldownSeconds. A man goes DOWN from a clean heavy (the move rows below), or when his LEG is injured: kickOnInjuredLeg.hits blows with location legs inside windowS seconds (the sim's own count, never a Jolt value or the M4 part HP), after which the NEXT blow of any move, a kick included, knocks him down; knockdown.minSecondsBetween keeps any cause from chaining him to the floor. Events (page only): KickInterrupted {target, ticks}, LegInjured {target, count, windowS}. SIM knockdown and finish window (V3 Dev, 2026-10-27; Strategy's ruling: the SIM owns the outcome, never a value out of Jolt). Behind ?feel=kick only (flag.query / flag.value): with the flag off the sim steps byte for byte as before (Gate 0). A kick, or a heavy blow that lands clean (not shrugged by poise, not on a guard), makes a FORCE: massBand (the attacker's mass over the target's, in whole percent, picks a per-mille from massBands) x stance (what the target was doing when the blow landed, from the sim's own phase) x the move's perMille, all whole per-mille integers, no pow / sqrt / transcendental. Force at or over knockdownAtPerMille = KNOCKDOWN: the target is stunned (phase hurt, nothing else) for knockdown.seconds + getUp.seconds, cannot be knocked down again until he is up, and the attacker's next heavy is the CRITICAL for finishWindow.seconds (the posture-break window's own mechanism: Fighter.critical). Below it = the ordinary stagger, unchanged. REAL TIME: every timer is whole sim ticks of the fighter that owns it (seconds x tickHz, 60 = sim.ts STEP), counted down once per tick, so each boss has his own clock and nobody else's fight slows, locks or dilates (Dom: a live MMO, others can attack at any time). PLACEHOLDER numbers (the Physics presentation rows in data/feel-kick.json mirror them until the ragdoll reads the sim's KnockedDown event). targets: who can be knocked down ('foe' = the opponents, 'hero' = the player's side); the hero stays out until Dom asks.
